$comment: What is actually in the gym, and WHERE, so a pairing rule has something to check against.
THE GYM CHANGED ON 2026-11-18. He moved and now trains at Smart Fit Pizarro, Jiron Pizarro 650, Trujillo
(a commercial gym: Matrix machines, kg plates and dumbbells, no pool). The Calgary file is kept verbatim at
content/gym/archive/equipment-calgary-2026-08.json and nothing reads it. The station ids are the same where
the same kind of fixture exists, so the catalogue, the week and the pairing rule keep working; what changed
is the evidence and the confidence on each one.
What the photos settle and what they do not. Four photos are of Pizarro itself (smartfit.com.pe gallery, ids
23248 to 23252, one a duplicate) and four more from its Google Maps listing (Maps photos of a different
gym, Full Forma, and a gym with red Hammer machines were in the same search and are NOT used). They show:
Matrix selectorised machines in a long row, Matrix plate-loaded machines, dual cable columns, tall frames
along the free-weight wall, round dumbbells on racks, plate trees with plates marked 20 and 10, flat
Olympic bench-press benches, adjustable benches, a bar holder with Olympic bars, a 20-inch plyo box, steps,
Life Fitness treadmills, stair climbers. They do NOT settle: whether the tall frames are squat racks or
Smith machines (or both), a pull-up bar on them, the assisted pull-up, a hip thrust machine, which
machine is which in the row, or the dumbbell steps. Those carry `open` questions for his first visit.
The rule this file makes checkable, in one line:
A SUPERSET MAY OCCUPY AT MOST ONE STATION.
A station is a fixture another member could want: a rack, a bench, a cable stack, one machine. The
partner exercise must occupy NO station (floor, mat, unanchored band, dumbbells, pure bodyweight) AND be
performable in the zone you are already standing in, which is what `floor` on each zone is for. Written
into HealthOS/HANDOFF.md on 2026-05-23 after Silvio rejected a bench-plus-row superset; validate.mjs
executes it.
Unknowns default to the SAFE direction. A false 'you have this' sends him to a machine that is not there,
while a false 'you lack this' only costs a swap. Where the week relies on a `carried` fixture, the card's
swap list holds the fallback.

$comment: Occupies NO station, so these carry `station: null` in program.json. They are the only legal superset
partners for a station lift, and a floor-needing one is only legal in a zone whose `floor` is true.
Dumbbells and kettlebells live here, NOT in `stations`: they are carried away and nobody is blocked while
you hold them. The BENCH is the station in a dumbbell exercise that uses one.
